headline: False

name: July school roll
headline: False

headline: False

name: Early learning participation before starting school
headline: False
caveat: Share of children starting school in Gisborne District who regularly attended early learning in the preceding six months. Quarterly points cover the year ended that quarter. Children with unknown attendance are excluded.

headline: False

name: Population projection · high
headline: False

name: Average residential electricity consumption
headline: False
caveat: Average kilowatt-hours drawn from the grid per residential connection in Gisborne Region. Self-consumed generation and weather adjustments are excluded.

name: Filled jobs
headline: False
caveat: Actual monthly filled jobs in Gisborne Region from Stats NZ employment indicators. Jobs are counted rather than individual people. Recent months may be revised.

name: New dwellings consented
headline: False
caveat: Monthly counts for Gisborne District. A consent is an approval and does not record a completed dwelling.

name: Value of building consents
headline: False
caveat: New and altered construction combined for Gisborne District, at current prices in New Zealand dollars.

name: Commercial accommodation guest nights
headline: False

name: Active commercial accommodation establishments
headline: False
caveat: Gisborne Region estimates cover commercial accommodation with at least six stay units.

headline: False

name: Year 11 students attaining NCEA Level 1
headline: False
caveat: Participation-based: share of Year 11 students entered for 80 or more Level 1 credits who attained NCEA Level 1. NZQA secondary school statistics for its Gisborne region, defined by the location of the student's school. Cumulative attainment by the end of the year for domestic students aged under 19 enrolled at a secondary school. NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. NZQA does not publish regional attainment by ethnicity.

name: Year 13 students attaining University Entrance
headline: False

NZQA attainment differs from the Ministry of Education school-leaver measure, which counts the highest qualification held when students leave school. headline: False
caveat: The 2023 Census figure is for Gisborne Region. The question asks whether people can have a conversation about everyday things in te reo Māori.

name: Gross greenhouse gas emissions
headline: False
caveat: Gisborne Region industry and household emissions, in kilotonnes of CO₂ equivalent. Uses the production approach and the residence principle. Excludes consumption-based emissions. Earlier years can be revised.

name: Students attending school regularly
headline: False
caveat: Percentage of students in Gisborne Region state and state-integrated schools who attended more than 90% of the term. COVID-19 affected comparability in 2020 and 2021. Reporting changed from Term 1 2025. CSV dates are the corresponding calendar-quarter boundaries for indexing by term.

name: Estimated resident population
headline: True
caveat: Estimated at 30 June. Rebased after each census (2023 rebase).

name: Median age
headline: False
caveat: Half the population is older and half younger. Estimated at 30 June.

name: Business locations (geographic units)
headline: True
caveat: Business locations (geographic units) with economic activity, at February each year. Counts randomly rounded.

name: Employees in business locations
headline: False
caveat: Employee count at February. Counts randomly rounded.

name: Filled jobs (LEED, quarterly)
headline: False
caveat: Total filled jobs in Gisborne Region from Stats NZ linked employer-employee data (LEED table 05). Jobs are counted rather than people. Published values are rounded. This quarterly series lags the monthly filled jobs series.

name: Median quarterly earnings, full-quarter jobs (LEED)
headline: False
caveat: Median earnings for the quarter from jobs held for the full quarter in Gisborne Region, from Stats NZ LEED table 05. Gross earnings at current prices, not adjusted for inflation or hours worked. Published values are rounded.

name: Worker turnover rate (LEED)
headline: False
caveat: Quarterly worker turnover rate (%) for Gisborne Region as published in Stats NZ LEED table 05. Turnover is seasonal, so compare the same quarter across years.

name: Sheep
headline: False

name: Beef cattle
headline: False
caveat: Total beef cattle in Gisborne Region at 30 June, from Stats NZ Agricultural Production Statistics (ADE AGR_AGR_003). Census years are full counts; other years are survey estimates.

name: Apple orchard area (hectares)
headline: False

name: People enrolled with a PHO
headline: False
caveat: Enrolled people by district of domicile at the start of each quarter, from April 2019.

name: Road deaths and serious injuries
headline: True
caveat: Calendar year. CAS is live: recent years may still change. Current year is year-to-date.

name: Road deaths
headline: False
caveat: Small annual numbers; read multi-year trends, not single years.

name: Registered light vehicles
headline: False
caveat: Light passenger and light goods vehicles (classes MA, MB, MC and NA) on the Motor Vehicle Register at the end of the month, by the registered owner's address in Gisborne District. Vehicles with a confidential owner listing are excluded. Monthly snapshots accumulate from October 2026.

name: Average age of light vehicles
headline: False
caveat: Years. Snapshot year minus the average vehicle year (year of manufacture) of registered light vehicles with an owner address in Gisborne District.

name: Plug-in share of light vehicles
headline: False
caveat: Battery electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles as a share of registered light vehicles with an owner address in Gisborne District, from the register's motive power field.

name: Hybrid share of light vehicles
headline: False
caveat: Petrol and diesel hybrids that do not plug in, as a share of registered light vehicles with an owner address in Gisborne District.

name: State highway traffic by monitoring site
headline: False
caveat: Annual average daily traffic (vehicles per day, both directions) published for state highway sites in NZTA's Gisborne region, by calendar year. Non-continuous sites are counted for some weeks and adjusted by NZTA. Blank cells have no published count.

name: People with finalised charges by court
headline: False
caveat: People of all ages, counted once a year at the court of their most serious finalised charge, for years ended June. Court location is where the final hearing was held, not where people live. Gisborne and Ruatōria courts can serve people who live outside Gisborne District.

name: People convicted by court
headline: False
caveat: People of all ages whose most serious finalised charge ended in conviction, by court location, for years ended June. Court location is where the final hearing was held, not where people live.
